title: Domo Engagement Content Payload
description:
Source-of-truth content payload for a Domo client engagement. Consumed by domo-interactive-proposal-builder (renders an interactive HTML proposal) and domo-proposal-pdf-renderer (renders a polished offline PDF). Designed multi-renderer-ready: numbers stay as numbers (computable), IDs are stable across renders, and prose fields support limited inline HTML (, ,
) so formatting survives both renderers. Schema v0.5.0 renames `phases` to `solutions` and `phase_id` to `solution_id` to match Domo's customer-facing engagement vocabulary; the rendered artifact merges the prior 'Phases & Scope' and 'Level of Effort' tabs into one 'Solutions, Scope & Effort' tab.

revision_label.description: Optional badge text shown in header (e.g. 'Accelerated 6-Month Plan').

prepared_by.description: Plain name strings only — e.g. ['Mark Lees'] or ['Mark Lees', 'Jane Smith']. Do NOT use objects. 1–2 entries. Seeded from meta.author in the discovery brief; ask for a co-presenter if applicable.

short_name.description: Acronym or shortened reference used in body text (e.g. 'PHA').

eyebrow.description: Small uppercase header text above the title (e.g. 'Statement of Work Proposal — Accelerated 6-Month Delivery').

title.description:
Engagement title shown in the document header. Use
for line breaks.

rate_default.description: Default hourly consulting rate ($/hr) used for ROI investment math. Not displayed on the rendered ROI tab.

paragraphs.description:
Each item renders as a

. Inline HTML allowed: , .

color_var.description: CSS variable for the pillar number bubble. Defaults to --cs1..cs4 by index.

phase_one_framing.description: Optional 'Solution 1 — The Right First Step' narrative section. Field name retained for backward field-mapping compatibility with the discovery brief skill; rendered headings use 'Solution 1' language.

value.description: Display value. Use plain integers — no tildes.

closing_callout.description: Optional defining-outcome callout at the bottom of the Executive Summary.

solutions.description: Ordered list of engagement solutions. Each solution is a customer-facing chunk of value the engagement delivers — Domo speaks in solutions rather than phases. The first solution is automatically rendered with the 'priority' visual treatment. (In schema versions <= 0.3.x this field was named `phases`; renamed to `solutions` in 0.5.0 to match the customer-facing vocabulary.)

id.description: Stable identifier (e.g. 'p1'). Used by timeline, ROI table, and cross-references. Pattern preserved across the rename so existing IDs continue to resolve.

subtitle.description: Short keyword summary shown under the solution title in the solution card header.

badges.description: Optional pre-sale outcome weight tags (omit if none apply; use multiple when a solution genuinely spans categories). core=foundational must-have; impact=highest-value outcome; quick-win=fast visible value; strategic=longer-horizon; phased=deferrable.

is_priority.description: True for the immediate-priority solution. Auto-true for the first solution if not specified.

recommended.description: Optional override of the legacy 85% rule. The rendered proposal no longer displays this value — every visible hour is the high-end sum from loe_rows. Retained for downstream tooling that may still read it.

color_var.description: CSS variable or hex for solution color accent. Defaults by index: --cs1, --cs2, --cs3, --cs4, --cs5.

description.description: Short narrative shown above the deliverables list when the solution card is expanded.

deliverables.description: Customer-facing deliverables for this solution. Each deliverable is an object with the short collapsed title plus three required detail fields that populate the click-to-expand panel in the rendered proposal.

title.description: Short customer-facing name shown in the collapsed deliverable list.

description.description: Customer-facing explanation of what the deliverable consists of — components, scope, where it lives, what the client receives. Avoid internal jargon and tool names unless meaningful to the customer.

audience.description: Who consumes or benefits from this deliverable (e.g. ['Executive sponsors', 'FP&A analysts']). One item per distinct audience; use the singular case as a 1-item array.

outcome_value.description: How this deliverable contributes to the solution objective and the broader project scope — the 'so what' for the customer. State the change in capability, decision speed, or business outcome this enables.

architecture_flow.description: Optional 'Solution X Technical Flow' diagram (Solution 1 typically has this).

loe_rows.description: LOE table rows for this solution. MUST include Solution Design, Build sub-items, QA/UAT, Rollout & Enablement, and Project Management (10–15%). The sum of loe_rows.hours.high is the canonical solution hour total — solutions[].hours.high is recomputed from this sum at render time.

id.description: Optional stable ID for this row.

category.description: Optional capability-area tag for the work item. Renders as a colored badge inside the merged Scope & Effort tab. Use only when the row clearly belongs to one of the four categories — generic rows like Solution Design, QA/UAT, Rollout, and Project Management should leave this field unset.

loe_summary.description: Supporting prose for the merged Scope & Effort tab. KPI tiles and totals are auto-computed from solutions — only loe_note prose needs to be authored.

loe_note.description: Closing prose block on the merged Scope & Effort tab. MUST cite the specific AI accelerators used to justify the leaner estimates.

solution_id.description: Solution ID (p1, p2, …) for grouping. Renamed from `phase_id` in schema 0.5.0.

count.description: Free text — e.g. '4 file types', '15–20 mapping tables'.

solution_id.description: Solution ID (p1, p2, …) for grouping. Renamed from `phase_id` in schema 0.5.0.

manifest_summary.description: Closing prose under the visualizations table.

implementation_strategy.description: 'Implementation Strategy' tab — pilot approach, communication principles, ACE callout, and the (mandatory) Domo Momentum Methodology section.

ace_callout.description: Optional ACE Support / Change Management Accelerator callout.

timeline.description: 'Timeline' tab. Bars are auto-rendered from solutions (using weeks_start/weeks_end and high-end hours).

color_var.description: Defaults to solution color by ordering.

assumptions.description: 'Assumptions' tab — four blocks: client responsibilities, Domo responsibilities, technical assumptions, out of scope.

msp_callout.description: Optional 'Recommended Add-On: Domo Managed Services' callout.

roi.description: 'ROI & Investment' tab. Total Investment is auto-computed from solution hours × rate. Drivers are authored.

investment_framing.description: loe-note style block under the cost table.

drivers.description: Quantifiable Value Drivers. MUST anchor to the specific project context (not generic).

title.default: Why Domo Consulting Delivers Outsized ROI

body.description: MUST cite AI-accelerated delivery, single-vendor accountability, pattern reuse across solutions, and platform-native primitives.

credit_impact.description: 'Credit Impact' tab — directional forecast of Domo credit consumption once the new solution is implemented and adopted. Optional at the top level: when omitted, the tab still renders with a 'forecast not yet provided' placeholder so tab order stays consistent across proposals. When provided, drivers MUST be enumerated by solution × category at the activity level (no category-summary-only shortcut), with low/high credit ranges for Years 1, 3, and 5. The tab is intentionally directional — the methodology block and closing callout exist to manage commercial risk and must not be removed.

intro.description: Opening paragraph explaining what credits are, why this section exists, and how it relates to the consulting investment from the ROI tab. ROI = value of the consulting work; Credit Impact = ongoing platform consumption to deliver that value. Together they give the client the full commercial picture.

methodology.description: Forecast methodology and assumptions. Required when credit_impact is present. The act of enumerating assumptions explicitly is a defensibility requirement, not a stylistic choice.

items.description: Bullets covering at minimum: user count assumptions, frequency assumptions, growth/adoption assumptions, what is excluded. Each bullet supports inline HTML (<strong>, <em>).

drivers.description: Per-driver credit consumption rows. Each driver row corresponds to a discrete activity (e.g. '5 Magic ETL flows × hourly refresh, full org partition'), tied to a solution and a category. Year fields are low/high integer pairs in absolute credits (e.g. 80000 = 80K). The renderer aggregates rows automatically into category subtotals and annual totals — author the drivers, not the totals.

solution_id.description: Solution id (p1, p2, …). Renamed from `phase_id` in schema 0.5.0.

category.description: Top-level credit category. Forces drivers into Domo's consumption-model vocabulary so the forecast lines up with how credits are billed and observed.

driver.description: Specific driver text — what is actually consuming credits (e.g. '5 Magic ETL flows × hourly refresh, full org partition' or '4 dashboards × 35 internal users × ~12 views/day').

current_envelope.description: Optional comparison to the client's current contracted credit envelope. Renders a 'Y1 lands at ~X% of today's envelope' framing tile. Omit for net-new logos with no prior envelope.

note.description: Optional supporting note rendered under the comparison framing.

recommendations.description: Optional efficiency patterns and re-forecast trigger points. Examples: incremental-vs-full ETL refresh, materialized aggregates vs live queries, AI primitive caching, when to re-baseline the forecast.

directional_callout.description: Closing directional-forecast callout. If omitted, the renderer emits a default disclaimer affirming this is a directional forecast verified during Solution 1 architecture review against actual workloads.

legal.description: e.g. '© 2026 Domo, Inc. · Confidential & Proprietary · Prepared for {Client}'.

footnote.description: Italic note below the legal line.

hide_credit_impact.description: Set true to suppress the Credit Impact tab entirely. Use when a credit forecast is not relevant to this engagement or should not be visible to the client.

feedback.description: Optional client feedback panel. When enabled, a floating Feedback button appears in the published proposal card, letting clients submit comments and SAs respond inline. Requires a deployed domo-proposal-feedback Cloudflare Worker.

enabled.description: Set true to activate the feedback panel in the rendered card.

worker_url.description: Base URL of your deployed Cloudflare Worker (e.g. 'https://domo-proposal-feedback.YOUR.workers.dev'). No trailing slash.

proposal_id.description: Stable slug for this proposal — used as the dataset partition key (e.g. 'pha-2026-v1').

proposal_sig.description: HMAC-SHA256 hex signature. Run worker/setup-sig.py to generate. Baked into the HTML at render time; authenticates feedback requests to the Worker without exposing the signing secret.
